walkthroughs.body_html:
Primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13…

Factor tree of 60 → 2 × 30 → 2 × 2 × 15 → 2 × 2 × 3 × 5. So 60 = 2² × 3 × 5.

Common conversions: ½ = 0.5, ¼ = 0.25, ⅛ = 0.125.

To add fractions, find a common denominator. ⅓ + ¼ = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12.

aᵐ × aⁿ = a^(m+n). aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = a^(m−n). (aᵐ)ⁿ = a^(mn).

a⁰ = 1. a⁻ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ. Example: 2³ × 2² = 2⁵ = 32.

mcqs.q: What is the value of x^0 (for x not equal to zero)?
options: (3x + 3)(2x + 3), by trying to factorise as a quadratic.
x^0 equals 0 because raising something to the zero gives nothing.
x^0 equals x because the zero has no effect.
1 — any non-zero number to the power of zero equals 1.
x^(1/2) means x divided by 2 — half of x.
x^(1/2) means 1 divided by x squared.
The square root of x (the positive root when x is positive).
x^0 equals x because the zero has no effect.
(3x + 3)(2x + 3), by trying to factorise as a quadratic.
3(2x + 9), by only dividing the first term by the common factor.
x^(1/2) means 1 divided by x squared.
3(2x + 3) — take out the common factor 3.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Prime”?
options: Power — number of times you multiply by itself
Whole number > 1 with only 1 and itself as factors
Highest common factor of two or more numbers
Whole number that divides exactly into another

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “HCF”?
options: Whole number > 1 with only 1 and itself as factors
Power — number of times you multiply by itself
Highest common factor of two or more numbers
Lowest common multiple of two or more numbers

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “LCM”?
options: Lowest common multiple of two or more numbers
Whole number > 1 with only 1 and itself as factors
Whole number that divides exactly into another
Highest common factor of two or more numbers

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Index”?
options: Power — number of times you multiply by itself
Lowest common multiple of two or more numbers
Result of multiplying a number by an integer
Whole number that divides exactly into another

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Multiple”?
options: Highest common factor of two or more numbers
Power — number of times you multiply by itself
Result of multiplying a number by an integer
Lowest common multiple of two or more numbers

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Factor”?
options: Result of multiplying a number by an integer
Lowest common multiple of two or more numbers
Whole number that divides exactly into another
Power — number of times you multiply by itself

free_texts.q: What is HCF short for? Three letters, lowercase.

sequence.def: A number that divides exactly into another.
The result of multiplying by an integer.
A number with exactly two factors, 1 and itself.
Highest common factor — uses shared factors.
Lowest common multiple — uses shared multiples.
A power like 2³ — compact repeated multiplication.
